# NullPunkt Solar Inc. - Calgary, Alberta

> German Precision - Zero Emissions. Rooftop solar installation in Calgary with optional battery storage and home energy management.

## Company facts

- Legal name: NullPunkt Solar Inc.
- Website: https://nullpunkt.ca
- Office: #2005 - 10th Avenue SW, Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Phone: (403) 819-7834
- Email: hello@nullpunkt.ca
- Service area: Calgary and Southern Alberta
- Status: Officially launched October 22, 2026 and accepting project enquiries. Launch does not establish completed Canadian installations.
- Founder: Tim Brunkel, principal directing mind and sole Director of NullPunkt Solar Inc.
- Ownership: wholly-owned Canadian subsidiary of SMB Solartechnik GmbH, a German company installing integrated systems since 2024.
- Electrical work: Alberta-licensed master electrician partners; the responsible partner and scope are confirmed in each proposal.
- No heat-pump installation services.

## Services and pricing

Residential rooftop PV sized to annual consumption, with optional battery storage and home energy management. Commercial and agricultural PV (15-200 kWp), developer partnerships, and system monitoring and maintenance.

No universal public installation price or launch discount is offered. Each project receives an individual CAD quote after a free roof and electricity-use assessment. Roof layout and condition, electrical upgrades, equipment, permits and optional storage determine the price. GST and included scope are identified in the proposal. No universal savings or payback promise.

## Solar sizing tools

Home and calculator tools provide illustrative module count, system size and annual production only. Assumptions: 500 W modules, 1,150 kWh/kWp/year and $0.22/kWh to approximate annual consumption from a monthly bill. The calculator's 4-15 kWp range is an illustrative tool range, not a minimum service size. Final sizing uses actual annual kWh, roof condition, shading and utility requirements.

A full electricity bill includes fixed and other charges that cannot all be avoided. Production is not the same as self-consumption or monetary savings. Export credits are not the full delivered bill rate.

## Programs and retailer options

Checked November 4, 2026. Confirm current terms before budgeting or applying.

- Calgary residential CEIP intake is closed until winter 2026/2027. The City lists estimated interest rates of 6.00%-6.10%, not 0%. Funding, eligibility, qualified contractors and final terms require City confirmation. Financing is not a rebate or guaranteed approval.
  Source: https://www.calgary.ca/environment/programs/clean-energy-improvement-program.html
- Canada Greener Homes Grant and Loan are closed to new applicants. Do not include them as funding for a new application.
- Alberta Micro-Generation Regulation supports eligible customer-generation and energy export credits. Actual credits depend on retailer terms; fixed charges and charges on imports may remain payable.
  Source: https://www.alberta.ca/micro-generation
- Solar Club is a retailer program, not a NullPunkt incentive. Rates, fees and switching conditions vary. Compare both import and export costs using current retailer terms; no fixed export rate is promised.
  Source: https://solarclub.ca/
- Clean Technology Investment Tax Credit eligibility is business- and equipment-specific, not a general homeowner rebate. Obtain qualified tax advice.
